name: cognai
description: CognAI is an intelligent, personalized cognitive companion built on the premise of **continuous learning and growth through user interaction**. Unlike standard conversational agents that suffer from context-window overflow or static personas, CognAI is designed to maintain long-term, coherent, and deeply personalized relationships. It achieves this by mimicking human neurobiology: separating working memory, episodic memory, and permanent semantic schemas into a dynamic, active reconstruction process.
